name: Chicken Egg Roll & Sesame Broccoli Rice Bowl with Sweet and Sour Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Arrange racks in the upper and lower positions.
While the oven is heating, transfer broccoli to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then toss to coat. Spread out in an even layer and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (510 g) bag broccoli florets
toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer spring rolls to another baking sheet (reserve sweet and sour sauce packets for serving). Drizzle spring rolls with oil, turn to coat, and arrange 1-inch apart on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (502 g) bag frozen chicken vegetable spring rolls
toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Once heated, place broccoli and spring rolls in the oven. Bake until broccoli starts to soften and spring rolls turn golden brown on the bottom side, about 10 minutes.
Remove spring rolls from the oven, flip, and return to the oven. Continue to bake until golden and crispy on both sides, 5 minutes more. Remove from oven and let cool slightly, about 2 minutes.
Remove broccoli from the oven, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and toss to coat. Return to the oven and continue to bake until tender-crisp, 3-5 minutes more. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, working one at a time, place rice pouches in the microwave, seam-side up. Heat on high for 3-4 minutes (until pouch balloons up with steam for 30 seconds). Allow steam to vent before opening pouch. (Alternatively, rice can be heated in a saucepan according to package instructions.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (283 g) pouch frozen Jasmine rice, pre-cooked

instructions.primary_message: Transfer spring rolls to a cutting board and halve crosswise.
To serve, divide rice, broccoli, and spring rolls between bowls; drizzle with sweet and sour sauce. Enjoy!
